title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the equilibrium temperature T_e.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the equilibrium temperature T'_e.

title: Equilibrium Condition for (a)
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the heat supplied by the pump to the heat lost by the building at equilibrium.

title: Comparison Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must clearly explain why T'_e is less than T_e, indicating the inefficiency of the heater compared to the heat pump.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms are consistent in units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors in (a)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect algebraic manipulation leading to an incorrect expression for T_e.

title: Common Errors in (b)
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid failing to correctly identify the relationship between W, T'_e, and T_e.
